text:
maria (sales): Heads-up — Montara wants to run the POC but procurement insists on splitting the PO across two legal entities (Montara Health Ops + Montara Research). They also handed back our MSA with a few DPA redlines and want an encrypted attachment proof for invoices. Can legal/finance advise on signature routing and whether we need two orderforms or one with entity-level billing?

sam (legal): Thanks — can you drop their redlines here? also need to confirm if they require counterparty signature on both the MSA and orderform or if a single exec sig + PO per entity suffices.

maria (sales): Dropping link to doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/montara-redline (redline uploaded). They wrote: "require tenant-scoped PO, separate invoice lines, and HSM-wrapped attachment receipts for invoices."

kevin (finance): For our billing system we can accept a single orderform with multiple billing entity sections, but legal wants the signature mapping clear. If they want separate PO numbers per entity we need that mapped to our GL codes. If they prefer two orderforms we need separate invoices and change to payment terms. What do they want for net terms?

montara-poc: (Montara) prefer single MSA signed by their GC, and separate POs per entity to go to each accounting team. Net30 is preferred. They want invoice attachments signed/encrypted and a receipt token proving the attachment hasn't been altered.

lee (solutions): Tech note: we can support generating an invoice receipt token via our billing service. Proposal sketch: single orderform with two billing blocks, each block contains PO number and tenant_id. On our side we route invoices using header mapping, e.g.:

```
POST /invoices
Headers:
  X-Tenant-ID: montara-research
  X-PO-Number: MR-2026-044
  Content-Type: application/pdf
```

We can attach a SHA256 receipt token stored in the invoice meta and provide an HSM envelope if they require key wrapping.

sam (legal): OK. Legal prefers separate signature lines per entity only if the entities are distinct contracting parties. If Montara confirms the two entities are both bound under the same contracting umbrella (they indicated yes), we can do single MSA with an appendix that maps PO numbers to entities and a signature from GC. Need to add indemnity/processor language for the DPA redlines — I'll propose language and push an annotated MSA.

olivia (sales-eng): One operational ask: if we do single orderform + billing blocks, we should add a signer-routing rule in the orderflow: billing_signer -> finance@montara, legal_signer -> gc@montara, exec_signer -> ceo@montara. That way the approval email for invoices goes to the right inbox.

kevin (finance): Sounds good. Two checkpoints: 1) We need explicit PO -> GL mapping from Montara for bookkeeping. 2) Net30 confirmed. Also confirm whether ACH or wire details differ per entity.

maria (sales): I'll ask Montara for PO mapping + bank details. Sam — can you draft the MSA appendix and a clean orderform template that contains two billing blocks + invoice token clause?

sam (legal): Yes. I'll post a redline by EOD. If the DPA redlines require processor-level changes, we may need an SOC addendum; I'll flag in the redline.

montara-poc: Great — we'll get the PO numbers and entity bank info by tomorrow. One more Q: can the invoice token be verified by their AP system automatically?

lee (solutions): Yes, we can output a JSON receipt alongside the PDF with fields: tenant_id, po_number, invoice_hash, timestamp, hsm_envelope_id. Example: {"tenant_id":"montara-research","po_number":"MR-2026-044","invoice_hash":"sha256:...","ts":"2026-03-23T18:04:00Z","envelope_id":"env_abc123"}. AP systems can validate the hash.

olivia (sales-eng): I'll add a short how-to for their AP: sample curl to fetch receipt:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/reciept/env_abc123
```

kevin (finance): small note — spelling of endpoint should be /receipt not /reciept :D

olivia (sales-eng): good catch :D fixed in the doc I'll push.

maria (sales): Thanks everyone. Next steps: Sam will post redline + appendix; Montara to provide PO numbers + bank details; Lee to confirm HSM envelope SLA and API sample; Kevin to confirm GL mapping after Montara sends PO mapping. I'll follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:

sam (legal): redline posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/montara-msaredline-v2 — please review. I added an appendix template section: "PO routing and entity mapping" and a clause for invoice receipt token verification.

lee (solutions): Verified HSM SLA: key wrap available, 99.9% availability, envelope TTL 90 days. I'll attach API spec to the doc.

montara-poc: Received — we'll review and come back with PO numbers and GL codes by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all.

maria (sales): closing loop — once we get PO details we'll route final orderform for signature. If anything blocks, ping me.
